contents.label: File contents
contents.placeholder: Paste CSV/TSV or pick a file, or paste a decklist

fallback.decklist_one: Read as a list: {{count}} card name.
fallback.decklist_other: Read as a list: {{count}} unique cards.
fallback.unrecognized: No table detected. Paste CSV text with headers or a decklist.

pickImport.description: Turn a TCGplayer or Shopify export, any CSV with a card name column, or a plain card list into a pick.

intros.source: Upload a file or paste its contents. A plain list like "4 Lightning Bolt" works too.
intros.columns: Choose which column holds each detail. Only the card name is required; leave anything your file doesn't have as "Not in this file".
intros.review: Check how the rows become orders, then create the pick.

pickImport.noAccess: Your role can't create picks. Ask an owner or admin to allow it in Settings > Business.

source.dropHint: or click to choose a file
source.pastePlaceholder:
Order #,Product Name,Quantity
1001,Sol Ring,1

or

4 Lightning Bolt
1 Sol Ring

columns.layoutHint: A saved layout is picked automatically when a file has the same columns.
columns.saveLayoutHint: Files with the same columns will use these choices automatically next time.

fieldHints.name: The card to pull. Variant text like "- Foil" is read too.
fieldHints.quantity: How many copies. Each row counts as 1 without it.
fieldHints.orderRef: Order number or name. Rows with the same value form one order.
fieldHints.setCode: Short set code, such as MH3. Narrows which printing is pulled.
fieldHints.setName: Full set name. Used when there is no set code.
fieldHints.condition: NM, LP, MP, HP or DMG, or words like Near Mint.
fieldHints.foil: Foil or non-foil. Yes/No, Foil/Normal and similar all work.
fieldHints.language: Card language, such as English or EN.
fieldHints.unitPrice: Sale price per card, used for revenue.

split.legend: How are the rows split into orders?
split.referenceHint: Rows with the same order number go together.
split.referenceDisabled: Match the order reference column in the previous step to use this.
split.masterdetailHint: A row with order details but no card starts a new order, and the card rows below it belong to it.
split.single: The whole file is one order
split.singleHint: Every row goes into a single order.

create.togetherHint: Recommended. Pull every card once by location, then sort them into orders.
create.separateHint: Each order gets its own pick and pull sheet.

review.ordersHint: Renaming an order changes its order reference on the pick.
